title: XF Summer Kickoff 2026
summary: Seventh annual. Over 170 teams from Washington and Oregon, three games each across Saturday and Sunday with no playoffs — an early-season run-out rather than a title.

title: Surf Cup NW 2026 (U8–U12)
summary: The younger weekend of Surf Cup NW, held in June for 2026 because of the World Cup. All games at 60 Acres in Redmond.

title: Surf Cup NW 2026 (U13–U19)
summary: Over 600 teams from across the US and Canada, drawn from GA, MLS Next, ECNL, ECNL RL, EA and USYS National League. All games at 60 Acres in Redmond; the winner of the Best of the Northwest bracket goes to the Surf Cup Championship.

title: Zipfizz Cup 2026
summary: An estimated 220 teams of all levels, every game on the grass at 60 Acres in Redmond.
